RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 30

An all-male panel is weak evidence by itself — it's the norm in bank risk functions and reflects the existing pipeline more than intent. On its own it proves nothing, and leading with it will make you look like you're reaching.

The stronger facts are: your credentials look objectively deeper on the stated criteria (PhD and nine years in the actual discipline versus a master's and vague "broad regulatory experience"), and they've ignored a reasonable request for written reasons for two weeks.

So chase the explanation first, in writing, with a deadline. Composition becomes relevant context only if the reasons they give are thin, shifting, or don't match the advertised criteria. Preserve the job ad and your correspondence now.
